第472章 敲在掌心里（第1页）
敲在掌心里（敲在掌心里（第22页）他低头看向李主任掌心——那只第三只手还在，但已经不再往外冒黑线了。三根线从李主任掌心穿过医护指缝，最后收进陈默的右手掌心里。线在他皮肤下游走。他成了新的节点。陈默盯着自己的右手，看见掌心皮肤鼓起一个包——不是血肿，是指节从内侧往外顶。一下，两下，节奏和门后敲击完全一致。李主任盯着陈默的手，声音低得几乎听不见：“我刚才……看见了第五个人。”“在哪里？”“在你身体里。”李主任的眼睛里闪过一丝恐惧，“不在你身后——在你身体里。像你体内还有一个人，正在学会怎么用你的手。”白灯开始闪。不是之前那种忽明忽暗的闪烁——是像电压不稳的抽动，灯管里的光越来越暗，每一次熄灭的时间都比上一次长。陈默低头看着自己的右手。掌心那个鼓包在动——指节从内侧往外顶，顶得皮肤发白，像有什么东西要从里面钻出来。他试着握拳，但手指不听使唤，五根指头像被线牵住，自己开始调整角度。拇指屈起。食指伸直。中指扣住无名指。这是一个敲击的手势。“别让它敲。”李主任的声音从牙缝里挤出来，“你让它敲了，你就是门的一部分——”陈默盯着自己的手。他知道李主任说得对。但他也知道，如果他不敲，医护的胸口会再次鼓起来，李主任掌心的第三只手会重新喷出黑线，这把剪刀会再次被举起来。黑线已经从他掌心钻进去了，已经和他右肩焦痕里的敲击声连接在一起了。不敲，就是死。敲了，还有一线生机。陈默深吸一口气，闭上眼。他在脑海里翻出三星堆考古现场的记忆——祭祀坑里的青铜神树，神树枝头的敲击节奏，那些被刻在青铜器上的符号，每一笔都对应一个声音。那不是随机的节奏，是一个封闭的循环，像门闩转动的轨迹。他要用这个节奏打乱门后的敲击。陈默睁开眼。右手动了。不是他在动——是掌心那个鼓包在引导他的手指，指节敲在瓷砖地面上。咚。咚。咚。三声。节奏不是门后的，是他从三星堆记忆里提取的祭祀节奏，错位半拍，像用错误的钥匙插进锁孔。门后安静了。但只有三秒。然后门后传出了回应——不是怪物声音，不是敲击声，是一个人的声音。陈默的声音。“别让他们知道，”门内的陈默说，“三星堆下面还有一扇门。”白灯彻底熄灭。黑暗里，陈默听见自己的心跳，听见李主任粗重的呼吸，听见医护胸口再次鼓起的闷响——咚，咚，咚，节奏和门内那个声音完全一致。他低头看向自己的右手。掌心那个鼓包还在动。但这次，不是从内侧往外顶。是从外侧往内里按。像有什么东西，正在试着握紧他的手。

Chapter 472 Knocked in the Palm (Page 1)
Knocked in the palm of the hand (Knocked in the palm of the hand (page 22)) He looked down at Director Li's palm - the third hand was still there, but the black threads no longer came out. The three threads passed through the doctor's fingers from Director Li's palm, and finally went into the palm of Chen Mo's right hand. The threads ran under his skin. He became a new node. Chen Mo stared at his right hand and saw a bulge on the skin of his palm - it was not a hematoma. Pushing the knuckles from the inside out. Once, twice, the rhythm is exactly the same as the knocking on the back of the door. Director Li stared at Chen Mo's hand, his voice was so low that it was almost inaudible: "I just... saw the fifth person." "Where?" "In your body." A trace of fear flashed in Director Li's eyes, "Not behind you - in your body. It seems that there is another person inside you, who is learning how to use your hands. . "The white light began to flash. It was not the flicker of light and dark before - it was like a twitching of unstable voltage. The light in the lamp was getting darker and darker, and each time it went out, it took longer than the last time. Chen Mo looked down at his right hand. The bulge in the palm of his hand was moving - the knuckles were pushing out from the inside, making the skin turn white, as if something was about to come out. He tried to make a fist, but his fingers refused to control him. The head of the finger was held by the thread and he began to adjust the angle. He stretched his index finger and clasped his ring finger. "Don't let it knock." Director Li's voice came out from between his teeth. "If you let it knock, you will become part of the door." But he also knew that if he didn't knock, the doctor's chest would bulge again. When he got up, the third hand of Director Li would spray out a black line again, and the scissors would be lifted up again. The black line had penetrated into the palm of his hand, and it was already connected with the knocking sound in the scorched mark on his right shoulder. If he knocked it, there was still a chance of survival. Chen Mo took a deep breath and closed his eyes, recalling the memory of the Sanxingdui archaeological site. The tapping rhythm of the branches, the symbols engraved on the bronze, corresponded to a sound. It was not a random rhythm, but a closed loop. He wanted to use this rhythm to disrupt the knocking on the door. It wasn't his right hand that was moving - it was the bulging in his palm that was tapping the tile floor. The sound was not from behind the door, but from the memory of Sanxingdui. It was half a beat, like a wrong key being inserted into the keyhole. But there was silence from behind the door. Then there was a response from behind the door - not a monster's sound, not a knocking sound. It was Chen Mo's voice. "Don't let them know," said Chen Mo from inside the door. "There is a door under Sanxingdui." Completely extinguished. In the darkness, Chen Mo heard his heartbeat, Director Li's heavy breathing, and the thumping sound in the doctor's chest. The rhythm was exactly the same as the sound inside the door. He looked down at his right hand and saw that the bulge in his palm was still moving.
